name: Oscillating cylinder (hydraulic lever)
description: A cylinder pivots on the ground at B0 and pushes a lever (the crank) at A. It is found in excavators, loaders, tailgates and dump beds. The operating range is the cylinder's stroke (distance from A to the swivel), so change it to match your cylinder's retracted and extended lengths. Over the full geometric range the crank could go all the way round, as in an oscillating-cylinder steam engine. A real cylinder's limited stroke keeps it a lever. The transmission angle is the angle between the cylinder and the lever.
